relativePaths: All image, state and evidence paths resolve relative to this original Photoshop proof package. Source paths are absolute. Workbook/guide anchors refer to sourceEvidence originals.

isolatedBase.finding: Native convertible body/chassis shell has empty wheel openings, with top, finished fascia and spoiler artwork supplied by separate layers.

source.fixedTopAppearance: Raised/closed in the inspected native scene; position is fixed.

choices.name: Carbon Flash-Painted Carbon Fiber Aero Package

evidence.scope: Spoiler only. Dive planes and CFZ ground effects remain fixed source artwork. Requires FEB plus J57, or is included with FEY; this proof does not represent a complete aero or performance package.

choices.name: Carbon Flash Metallic Three-Stanchion High Wing Spoiler

evidence.scope: Not available with T0F or FEY.

coverage.notice: Spoiler artwork preview for a 2027 Grand Sport Convertible 3LT in the selected paint. The convertible top position, wheels, interior and other equipment remain fixed and may differ from your build.
limitations: T0F shows its spoiler only. Dive planes and CFZ ground effects are not represented as package-dependent changes.
T0F requires FEB plus J57, or is included with FEY. The fixed source equipment does not prove a complete T0F, FEB or FEY build. 5ZV conflicts with T0F and FEY.
The convertible top position is fixed. Paint recipes select exact CM9 roof and left/right tailgate paint variants; they do not animate the top or prove D84/D86 finish combinations.
Coupe CF7/CC3 removable-roof options are not available on this convertible and are not inherited.
S0267 low-spoiler aliases are not bound to T0E. SIG and ZYC finish variants are outside this proof.
5V5 and T0G have no current Grand Sport option identity and are excluded. No unsupported spoiler RPO or wheel identity is inferred from artwork labels.
Only this convertible 3LT camera view, ten listed paints and two listed spoiler appearances are qualified. Other models, bodies, trims, views and component choices are unqualified.
This is a component preview, not a complete configured car or legal-build proof. Catalog evaluation remains authoritative for option compatibility.
coverage.fallback: Hide artwork or show an explicit unavailable state outside the exact covered model/year/body/trim/paint/spoiler scope. Do not silently substitute.

validation.visualInspection: All ten paint choices inspected as composed full scenes, including matching convertible roof and left/right tailgate paint families. Raised top position is fixed. T0F and 5ZV inspected at spoiler detail scale for geometry and native mount occlusion; isolated convertible body/chassis inspected separately.
